sources.entry: Notenik - Note-taking app with many organizational options.

summary.one_liner: Notenik is a Swift/AppKit note-taking app for the Mac, with this repo holding the older (pre-2025) Mac UI code.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Notenik as a note-taking application written in Swift for the Mac. This repository contains the Mac UI, written with AppKit/Cocoa, updated through roughly the end of 2024. The README lists related repos covering shared logic (NotenikLib), general utilities (NotenikUtils), a basic Textile parser (NotenikTextile), and a custom Markdown parser (NotenikMkdown). Documentation is kept as Notenik Collections written in Markdown, and the app's website files are in a separate Website collection. Third-party packages used include cmark, Down, Ink, SwiftSoup, XMLCoder, ZIPFoundation, and others. The README does not describe specific note features in detail, so the "many organizational options" wording from the index entry is not confirmed here.
use_cases: Taking and organizing notes on a Mac
Reading Notenik source code to learn about a Swift AppKit app
Studying a custom Markdown parser implementation
Reviewing Notenik documentation written as Markdown collections
how_to_run: Download the app from the Mac App Store (link given in the README)
Open the Notenik-25 repo for the latest code (this repo is no longer maintained)
notable: Custom Markdown parser (NotenikMkdown) developed alongside the app
Documentation maintained as Notenik Collections in Markdown
Split into several repos: UI, core library, utilities, Textile parser
